name: Terra Communications (SA)
summary: SA local-call dialup (Adelaide, Gawler, Tanunda, Willunga, Port Lincoln) + business access ISP (principal Luke Vanderfluit); gone by ~1999 (TERRA COMMUNICATIONS (SA) PTY LTD, ACN 079 861 242).

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of own domain (by 1996).
Acquired by Camtech — domain 302-redirected to Camtech.

refs.label: 28 Nov 2001; earlier 2001 captures still served Terra content.
Own signup page footer names the company.
Camtech confirms the same legal entity and the Apr-1999 handover.
ASIC-derived registry data gives the ACN; deregistered 2001, before/without an ABN being issued, hence absent from ABR.
